page.overview:
Who is Macdonwald?

Do swarm upon him — from the Western Isles,

Of kerns and gallowglasses is supplied."

A disgruntled Scottish nobleman allied with Norwegian invaders. Is killed by Macbeth in battle before the play's events, prompting his ascent to Thane of Cawdor. Contrary to popular belief, he is not the Thane himself, but merely an ally of his on the rebel side.

Macdonwald allies himself with the king of Norway, and participates in their attempted invasion of Scotland as a rebel leader.
